top_categories.workout_context: 71 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
78ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At 5 Mila Marche Gran Fondo, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
5 Mila Marche Gran Fondo's mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 71 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic 5 Mila Marche Gran Fondo's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before September.
5,577ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of 5 Mila Marche Gran Fondo. Train it until it feels boring.
Base fitness for 5 Mila Marche Gran Fondo. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
5,577ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At 5 Mila Marche Gran Fondo, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Low-cadence force work for 5,577ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on mixed terrain. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.

race_overlay.heat: September in Porto Recanati (MC), Marche, Italy can bring heat. If the forecast warrants it, include controlled heat exposure before 5 Mila Marche Gran Fondo and rehearse the drinking and electrolyte plan you tolerate in training. Do not introduce a fixed sodium protocol solely from this preview.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for 5 Mila Marche Gran Fondo’s 71 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at 5 Mila Marche Gran Fondo. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at 5 Mila Marche Gran Fondo requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, TT Threshold, and Over Under to prepare you for 71 miles of mixed terrain in Porto Recanati (MC), Marche, Italy.
